Then we get into The Big 3 topics of this week: An ILLIT fans gets real about their concert quality, Heeseung is officially NOT coming back to ENHYPEN, and BTS faces backlash over the Arirang teaser. Plus Hot Issues — is ILLIT copying BLACKPINK now?? Is CORTIS at Lollapalooza is giving HYBE payola? Jisoo's acting has the internet in shambles (again), and NingNing is in hot water over a weight comment. We close out at the Open Bar. So sit back relax and grab a drink!
